decision.priority_rule_applied: Brief section 3, rule 2 — a dedicated comments branch exists, so its work is continued
why_a_new_branch_rather_than_committing_: The new branch starts AT the proven comments tip 9437439, so the entire comments history is preserved as ancestry — nothing is lost, nothing is cherry-picked, and provenance needs no reconstruction.
The scope manifest fixes ALLOWED_BRANCH_PREFIX=claude/community-comments-; cursor/community-comments-01 is outside that prefix.

The cursor branch belongs to a different harness session. Writing to it risks colliding with a writer this profile cannot even enumerate (ps is denied), so a fresh branch is the non-interfering choice.
This is not the section-3 rule-4 case: rule 4 names a base-less fresh start, whereas this branch is rooted in the proven comments contour, not in a random ratings, SEO or template HEAD.
decision.base_justification: 9437439 is the tip of the only dedicated comments contour. Its merge-base with main is 64bb55c. It deliberately excludes the final ratings tip ec29b2c, so no ratings work is carried in or put at risk.
